stepD2.symptomDescription: A high percentage of the parts produced have scratches on the surface.
stepD2.problemDescription: The scratches on the parts lead to an increased scrap rate and affect product quality.

causes.report: A detailed report was prepared documenting the analysis, the hypotheses tested, and the root cause identified.
